intent: Freeze the already-validated Longcycle semantic and continuity foundation as Architecture Baseline v1.0.0, without creating a second semantic-owner system or opening new industry/research work. Keep the existing Capability Registry authoritative for reuse/extend/replace/new ownership, add an orthogonal L1/L2/L3/L4 Baseline risk contract and machine gate, switch future Agent development from open-ended architecture exploration to Baseline-preserving product/domain extension, and preserve historical architecture/research documents unchanged as development provenance.
rationale_summary: Three real industry proving grounds, the repository capability/repair-memory governance, migration 0039 provenance hardening, exact-head PostgreSQL/full CI and an externally maintainer-accepted Fresh-Agent v3 drill have made the stable cross-industry semantic boundary explicit enough to stop open-ended architecture search. Baseline v1 locks what counts as correct while leaving implementation, industry/domain catalogs, product surfaces and productionization free to evolve. L1-L4 risk classification is deliberately orthogonal to the existing owner-disposition system so the freeze does not introduce a parallel semantic registry.
